formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d₁ : Point) (d₂ : Point) (AB : Line) (BC : Line) (AD : Line), ((formParallelogram a b c d₁ AB BC AD d₂) ∧ (Triangle.onLine a AD) ∧ (Triangle.onLine c AD) ∧ (Line.intersectsLine AB BC)) → (Triangle.congruent △ a:b:c △ c:d₁:d₂)
formalizations.full_output: theorem triangles_on_same_base_between_parallels_are_equal (a b c d₁ d₂ : Point) (AB BC AD : Line) (h1 : formParallelogram a b c d₁ AB BC AD d₂) (h2 : Triangle.onLine a AD) (h3 : Triangle.onLine c AD) (h4 : Line.intersectsLine AB BC) : Triangle.congruent △ a:b:c △ c:d₁:d₂ := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (D : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine b c D) ∧ (a ≠ b) ∧ (a.onLine D) ∧ (b.onLine D) ∧ ((Triangle.area △ a:b:c) = (Triangle.area △ b:c:a))) → ((Triangle.area △ a:b:c) = (Triangle.area △ b:c:a))
formalizations.full_output: theorem same_base_parallels (a b c : Point) (D : Line) (h1 : distinctPointsOnLine b c D) (h2 : a ≠ b) (h3 : a.onLine D) (h4 : b.onLine D) (h5 : (Triangle.area △ a:b:c) = (Triangle.area △ b:c:a)) : (Triangle.area △ a:b:c) = (Triangle.area △ b:c:a) := by

nl_statement: Triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.  Let $ABC$ and $DBC$ be triangles on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $AD$ and $BC$. I say that triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$. <prf> Thus, triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$.Thus, triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
